<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 30px 0 15px; padding: 0; display: block; border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(52, 174, 252, 1)"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 20px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: bold; display: block"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0">应用配置</strong></span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h3>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 30px; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">点击应用卡片或新增应用进入应用配置界面。</p>
<h4 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 30px 0 15px; display: block; padding: 0 12px; border-left: 6px solid rgba(52, 174, 252, 1)"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 18px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: bold; display: block"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0">1.基础信息</strong></span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h4>
<ul data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="list-style-type: disc; margin: 8px 0; padding: 0 0 0 25px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px">
<li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal"><p style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 30px; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0">应用简介</strong>：概述应用定位与核心能力，供用户参考，必填，限制200字符</p>
</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal"><p style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 30px; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0">开场白</strong>：首次进入对话时，系统触发的第一条响应消息，非必填，限制500字符</p>
</section></li></ul>
<h4 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 30px 0 15px; display: block; padding: 0 12px; border-left: 6px solid rgba(52, 174, 252, 1)"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 18px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: bold; display: block"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0">2.检索配置</strong></span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h4>
<ul data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="list-style-type: disc; margin: 8px 0; padding: 0 0 0 25px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px">
<li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal"><p style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 30px; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0">场景增强</strong>：支持多场景自由勾选与联动，实现叠加多种增强效果</p>
<ul style="list-style-type: disc; margin: 8px 0; padding: 0 0 0 25px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px">
<li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0">本地生活</strong>：开启后，系统将支持对当前位置进行周边酒店、餐饮及公共设施等精准检索，当与“图文并茂”同时打开，可增加附带图片的 POI卡片信息展示</section></li></ul>
</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal"><p style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 30px; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0">智能改写</strong>：模型对原始query进行标准化重构，可以优化检索匹配度，建议开启</p>
</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal"><p style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 30px; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0">垂域工具</strong>：配置垂域工具，模型会依据query上下文自动锁定最佳检索源，可实现即时性与高精度召回双重提升</p>
</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal"><p style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 30px; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0">信息时效性范围限制</strong>：支持自定义时间跨度，实现时间区间定向检索功能</p>
</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal"><p style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 30px; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0">指定检索范围</strong>：开启后，单击<strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0">配置</strong>，在弹出的<strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0">指定检索范围</strong>对话框中单击+ 添加网站，输入目标网站域名（最多100个），例如<code style="height: auto; color: rgba(30, 107, 184, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); width: auto; margin: 0 2px; padding: 2px 4px; border-top: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-bottom: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-left: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-right: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 4px; overflow-wrap: break-word; font-family: Consolas, Monaco, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all">tieba.baidu.com</code>、<code style="height: auto; color: rgba(30, 107, 184, 1); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(27, 31, 35, 0.05); width: auto; margin: 0 2px; padding: 2px 4px; border-top: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); border-bottom: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-left: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-right: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 4px; overflow-wrap: break-word; font-family: Consolas, Monaco, Menlo, monospace; word-break: break-all">baike.baidu.com</code>，单击<strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0">确定</strong>完成配置，系统将优先从此范围网站获取信息，若无匹配信息则会切换至其他网站搜索，实现"精准优先 + 全域保障"的双重覆盖机制</p>
</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal"><p style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 30px; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0">单轮检索条数</strong>：数量越高信息越全，但会占用更多资源，增加耗时</p>
</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal"><p style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 30px; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0">网页深度阅读</strong>：开启后将提升检索效果，但会增加耗时</p>
</section></li></ul>
<h4 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 30px 0 15px; display: block; padding: 0 12px; border-left: 6px solid rgba(52, 174, 252, 1)"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 18px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: bold; display: block"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0">3.策略配置</strong></span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h4>
<ul data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="list-style-type: disc; margin: 8px 0; padding: 0 0 0 25px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px">
<li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal"><p style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 30px; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0">自动判定</strong>：由模型自行判断是否需要联网构建回复</p>
</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal"><p style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 30px; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0">边想边搜模式</strong>：模型会根据query难易程度自动决策检索范围及轮次</p>
</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal"><p style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 30px; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0">极速模式</strong>：系统以最小化响应时间（RT）为核心，适用于高并发、低延迟需求，建议仅在对耗时敏感、对召回精度容忍度较高的场景中启用</p>
</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal"><p style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 30px; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0">自定义干预搜索的触发策略</strong>：支持自然语言精确控制检索范围（如特定主题/地域），当查询命中预设的检索范围时，会触发外部数据检索，若判定为非相关领域，系统将直接调用模型自身的通用知识进行响应</p>
</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal"><p style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 30px; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0">强制检索</strong>：所有查询均自动触发联网检索</p>
</section></li></ul>
<h4 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 30px 0 15px; display: block; padding: 0 12px; border-left: 6px solid rgba(52, 174, 252, 1)"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 18px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: bold; display: block"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0">4.生成配置</strong></span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h4>
<ul data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="list-style-type: disc; margin: 8px 0; padding: 0 0 0 25px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px">
<li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal"><p style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 30px; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0">system prompt</strong>：检索及生成时会根据填入信息执行约束策略，限制1万字符</p>
</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal"><p style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 30px; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0">百度词条下划线</strong>：开启后，模型会根据生成结果，自动解析语义结构并优选代表性词条，无需人工干预</p>
</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal"><p style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 30px; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0">图文并茂</strong>：开启后，在生成结果中会输出文字及穿插上下文关联图像，实现图文深度融合的效果</p>
</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal"><p style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 30px; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0">相关视频</strong>：开启后，在生成结果中均会附加与上下文相关的视频素材，并统一置于内容底部，构建沉浸式多模态回答</p>
</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal"><p style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 30px; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0">追问</strong>：开启后，在生成结果后均有1-3个相关问题提示，选择提示问题后会参考历史对话内容及system prompt信息进行回答</p>
</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal"><p style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 30px; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0">引用</strong>：开启后，系统将在生成内容中涉及检索来源的段落处，自动增加数字角标，实现信息来源的可视化追溯</p>
</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal"><p style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 30px; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0">设置角标样式</strong>：支持根据需求灵活配置角标的外观样式</p>
</section></li></ul>
<h3 data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 30px 0 15px; padding: 0; display: block; border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(52, 174, 252, 1)"><span class="prefix" style="display: none"></span><span class="content" style="font-size: 20px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); line-height: 1.5em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: bold; display: block"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0">应用测试</strong></span><span class="suffix" style="display: none"></span></h3>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 30px; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">配置完成后，可在输入框输入query进行测试，测试结果将展示检索回答内容、参考来源链接、token 统计信息（输入/输出/用时）及推荐追问问题。</p>
<ul data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="list-style-type: disc; margin: 8px 0; padding: 0 0 0 25px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px">
<li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal"><p style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 30px; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0">附件上传</strong>：</p>
<p style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 30px; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">数量限制：单次最多支持上传 10 张图片</p>
<p style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 30px; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">文件大小：单张上限 4MB</p>
<p style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 30px; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">支持格式：JPG/JPEG、PNG、WebP、BMP、JPE</p>
</section></li><li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal"><p style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 30px; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0"><strong style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold; background: none left top / auto no-repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0">位置信息</strong>：系统支持自动定位/手动录入双重位置获取模式，在此基础上，提供从身边便民搜索到全城吃喝玩乐指南，再到一站式的旅行规划服务，全方位满足多样化的出行与生活需求。</p>
</section></li></ul>
<p data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 30px; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">以下为具体示例：</p>
<ol data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="list-style-type: decimal; margin: 8px 0; padding: 0 0 0 25px; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
<li><section style="margin-top: 5px; margin-bottom: 5px; color: rgba(1, 1, 1, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8em; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; font-weight: normal"><p style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 30px; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">基于位置的周边POI检索</p>
<p style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 30px; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">支持基于位置的周边设施查询（如附近公园），应用配置：开启本地生活+图文并茂</p>
<p style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 30px; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">结果页综合展示：</p>
<p style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 30px; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">基础信息：距离、地址、营业状态</p>
<p style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 30px; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">决策参考：评分、特色标签</p>
<p style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 30px; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">视觉预览：实景图片展示</p>
</section></li></ol>

<p style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-size: 16px; line-height: 30px; letter-spacing: 0; text-align: left; text-indent: 0; margin: 0; padding: 8px 0">支持多图轮播展示，可通过左右箭头切换浏览图片，点击任意图片即可触发放大预览模式，查看高清细节，提升内容阅读质感。</p>
</section></li></ol>
<figure data-tool="mdnice编辑器" style="margin: 10px 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center"><img alt="" style="display: block; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 100%; border: 3px none rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); border-radius: 0; object-fit: fill; box-shadow: 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)" data-src="http://icms-x-dita-hz.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/zh-CN/images/p1080214.png?Expires=7258146057&amp;OSSAccessKeyId=STS.NZJ8ee1WrvckfadoWQrUkUBrn&amp;Signature=35d%2F7RiI7mMOa6HsvV0PbhvSdH8%3D&amp;security-token=CAISzgJ1q6Ft5B2yfSjIr5n%2Fc9%2FR3IhTwaGAZEfVi1cEftpHuofZjDz2IHtEfHFvBu4fsPsxm29Y7foclqZdVplOWU3Da%2BB364xK7Q756ks2Bkvuv9I%2Bk5SANTW5KXyShb3%2FAYjQSNfaZY3eCTTtnTNyxr3XbCirW0ffX7SClZ9gaKZ8PGD6F00kYu1bPQx%2FssQXGGLMPPK2SH7Qj3HXEVBjt3gX6wo9y9zmn5zCu0OH0wGqlrRO%2FtypGPX%2BMZkwZqUYesyuwel7epDG1CNt8BVQ%2FM909vcfqW%2Bf4Y7DWgcOvUrZY7GIrMcUJQt4d7U8FaVIofb1iPlkoOvXmpRJRpfKsXy0OM62ZvdDoKOscIvBXr6yZebmtOhSfPo7l4gnwuI14E9qpc5wAa4FAFVedzKitF80pFHpNn5kHGnNhdbntINy5f5fqzNMlZ52hcHRK93xGoABg8O%2FjVJoqQrCZIhrMkWpOI9l9IhQ5YKw1SRNtpamB0uoGR4%2FTWhN2nUw6ZokjWQ6KA0rLmv5t8qI3KP28Yway%2BVNOxMK5qQcSceP2hX6vQSnE0sn7OkQH0x1dh0pf23WruFIq4Fmwl5Tk54s6AJBju6ARcz%2B0L7Y%2BMpDdgn6e7UgAA%3D%3D" class="lazyload"></figure>
